// notes: Ready-to-use Claude Desktop config for the expense-management MCP server.
1. Make sure the backend API is running (uvicorn app.main:app on port 8000).
2. Copy the 'expense-mgmt' block into your real config at:
(merge into an existing 'mcpServers' object if you already have one).
3. Either set EXPENSE_API_TOKEN to a JWT from POST /auth/login, OR leave it out and just
tell Claude: 'log in as finance@demo.local' — the login tool holds the token for the session.
4. Restart Claude Desktop. The 64 tools appear under the expense-mgmt server.
Tokens expire after 8h; re-login via the tool or paste a fresh one.

env.EXPENSE_API_TOKEN: <paste a JWT from POST /auth/login, or omit and use the login tool>
